Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas

substance noun

a material, stuff

also material, stuff (material), matter (physical)

classical

Cic. N.D. 3.92: māteria rērum, ex quā et in quā sunt omnia (Lewis & Short)
Ov. Met. 2.5: māteriam superābat opus

māteria, māteriae f.

noun, first declension; also māteriēs, māteriēī f. (nom. and acc. sing.)

stuff, matter, material

What a thing is made of. Of trees it is timber for building, as against ligna, firewood; it is also the subject matter of a speech or a book (see subject). For a chemical see chemical.

Examples

  • māteriam superābat opus

    the workmanship surpassed the materialOv. Met. 2.5

  • Ex quā māteriā facta est haec pila?

    What is this ball made of?composed

See also chemical, subject, wood, cloth, consist of.

SourcesLewis & Short: materia

The example sentences marked “composed” are ours.
